title: Curly-Haired Toddler, Sunlit Porch Steps - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet mid-20th-century candid snapshot of a curly-haired toddler resting on a sunny porch stoop next to a textured stucco wall. Dappled natural sunlight and tree shadows fall across the scene, highlighting the child's striped short-sleeve shirt, shorts, cuffed socks, and high-top baby walking shoes. The reverse features a faint photo-lab processing stamp.
